$schema_doc: Placement constraints for the LM2596S-5 buck converter (U1 + L1 + D1 + C1 + C2 + C4 + C56). Topology per TI SNVS124 Figure 9-13: SW_NODE is a single short copper pour shared by U1.2, D1.cathode, and L1.1, with nothing else on that copper. CIN (C1/C4) sits on the U1.1 VIN side OUTSIDE the SW loop. COUT (C2/C56) sits on the L1.2 +5V side OUTSIDE the SW loop. Distances are center-to-pin and include half the target's body width. Run `python3 hardware/pcb/v2/tools/check_buck_placement.py`.

constraints.rationale: Inductor pad 1 (SW side) touches U1.2 via a short SW_NODE copper. 12x12mm body half-width 6mm plus U1 courtyard half-width 5.65mm plus ~0.5mm DRC clearance sets L1 center ~12.2mm east of U1; adding the 2.65mm y offset from U1 pin row center gives ~14.5mm center-to-pin. 15mm gives small margin for routing jitter.

Catch diode cathode on the SW_NODE pour. SMA body 4.4x2.6mm. D1 sits perpendicular to the SW trace (rotation 90 or 270), cathode pad touching the SW copper, anode hanging off toward the GND pour. Physical floor is ~6.5mm because the SMA body has to clear U1's courtyard south edge, which is 6.45mm below U1 center. Budget relaxed to 7.5mm: 7.0mm proved unrealistic given surrounding placement, and 7.5mm is still well inside what the LM2596 cares about at its switching frequency.

Output bulk on +5V rail at L1.2. 8x6.5mm SMD aluminum electrolytic. Must sit OUTSIDE the SW loop, on the far side of L1 from U1. Pad span ~5.6mm plus L1 half-width 6mm plus clearance sets center-to-L1.2 minimum around 8-9mm; 10mm gives margin for routing around adjacent non-buck parts.

Input bulk reservoir on +12V rail at U1.1. Panasonic FK series EEEFK1E471P (LCSC C248607), 10x10.2mm SMD aluminum electrolytic, 260°C reflow rated. 470uF is TI's LM2596 datasheet reference value (SNVS124 Fig 9-13). Precise position not critical because the HF transient demand is handled by C4. Sits on the U1.1 VIN side, OUTSIDE the SW loop. 15mm gives realistic freedom to fit the can near VIN.

High-frequency +12V bypass directly at U1 VIN pin. C4 is an 0805 (2x1.25mm body); its pad-to-pad span (1.9mm) exceeds U1 pin pitch (1.7mm) so it cannot sit between adjacent U1 pins. Best achievable is ~4mm offset from U1.1 with the body just clearing the courtyard.

+5V output HF bypass companion to C2. Aluminum electrolytic C2 has significant ESR at switching frequencies; ceramic 100nF restores fast transient response at the +5V rail. Target changed from U1.4 (FB) to L1.2 (post-inductor rail) because that is where the ceramic actually belongs in the TI reference.
